modern: The substance of the universe is obedient and compliant; and the reason which governs it has in itself no cause for doing evil, for it has no malice, nor does it do evil to anything, nor is anything harmed by it. But all things are made and brought to completion according to this reason.

explained.summary: The universe isn’t out to get you. The stuff everything is made of simply goes where it’s shaped, and the reason that shapes it, the intelligence Marcus sees running through nature, has no malice in it. It does no wrong and harms nothing. Everything that comes into being and comes to an end happens by that same orderly reason, so there’s no hidden cruelty to resent.
